notes.text: SPEC.md written (plugins/lab-notebook/SPEC.md). Choices beyond the plan: goals also start pending when Claude-authored (otherwise Claude could add a goal to justify an experiment); no supersede command, supersession takes effect when the superseding node is established (so it is gated by confirm); added reject command and rejected status for pending goal/conclusion/decision; hypothesis supported/refuted and question answered require a supported conclusion linked to it; nb predict keeps predictions and tests links in step. Fixture being written by a sub-agent.
